data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net release from prior year reserves of GBP 30.1m in 2018, driven by more favourable claims development and efficient claims handling. This release partially offset current year natural catastrophe losses of GBP 22.8m (California wildfires, Hurricane Michael, Hurricane Florence). Prior years (notably 2016 and 2017) were previously impacted by major catastrophe events (Alberta wildfires and Hurricane Matthew in 2016; Hurricane Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico earthquake and California wildfires in 2017). Reinsurance recoveries and a GBP 2.7m bad debt release related to World Trade Centre recoveries also contributed to the favourable movement.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was located in the technical reserves movement notes. The report explicitly states a prior year release of GBP 30.1m in the narrative (used here) but that figure appears to be a NET release in context. A gross PYD figure was not found; fallback to the narrative net release was used. Claims development triangle (gross) is available and has been included; it could be used to calculate a gross PYD but was not unambiguously reconciled to a single explicit gross prior-year movement in the notes.
